cards.name: NOCO Boost Plus GB40 1000A Jump Starter
cards.badge: Product of the day · the value pick in jump starters
cards.price: List price $99.95 at NOCO's store; Amazon has been tracked between about $60 and $125 (camelcamelcamel, as reported in October 2026; Big Deal Days 2025 was reported at $79.96)
cards.buy_if: you drive a car, SUV or small truck with a gas engine up to 6.0L (or a diesel up to 3.0L) and want a jump starter that lives in the glovebox for emergencies.
cards.skip_if: you have a big diesel truck or a heavy V8 you park outside in deep cold (look at the NOCO GB70 or GB150), or you will never remember to recharge it twice a year.
cards.owners: Amazon US showed about 4.6 stars from roughly 112,000 ratings in an undated search snapshot. Owners praise the size, the spark-proof clamps and ease of use; the complaints are short clamp cables, capacity loss after a year or two and forgetting to recharge.
cards.video_title: How to jump start using your NOCO Boost GB40
cards.video_why: The three-step jump-start routine, shown on a real car; the title came from a search-result URL.

buy.pick: The NOCO Boost Plus GB40 (1000A, model GB40) with the clamps and USB cable in the box; the bigger GB70 only if you own a large diesel
buy.check: Sold by Amazon.com or NOCO; the listing says GB40 and 1000A (not 2000A+ claims from no-name brands). There is no wall charger in the box, so you need a USB-A charger
